status: Proto-personas and hypothesised journeys, drawn from each group's published needs and from what comparable registers answer. No primary research has been done yet; each must be tested with real users before it is treated as a finding.

personas.goal: Scope which bodies a policy, return or review affects, and which rules already bind them
tasks: Find every body of a type in a nation
See which rulebooks and laws apply to each
Check who leads internationally on a topic
routes: Filter the register by type, purpose and nation
Rules that apply, on each profile
Org chart by type and purpose
personas.success: A defensible in-scope list, with sources, in under 30 minutes
personas.test: Will reuse the CSV or feed rather than the page

personas.goal: Use one reference list of public bodies with every code other systems use
tasks: Download the concordance of identifiers
Query the data without installing anything
Map bodies to org-ids for open data standards
personas.success: Joins their system's records to the register by code, not by name
personas.test: Judges it on stability, the feed contract and identifier coverage

personas.goal: Know who is a contracting authority, who answers for spending and where the money and ownership sit
tasks: Check whether Managing Public Money or a devolved equivalent applies
Trace accountability to the accounting officer's department
See trading funds, public corporations and PFI
routes: Rules that apply, on each profile
Trading fund and public corporation trees
personas.success: Can cite the rule and the chain for any body in an assurance report
personas.test: Trusts the page only where every link names its source

personas.goal: Hold the right minister and body to account, and scrutinise treaties and appointments
tasks: Find who a body answers to and through which minister
See the treaties and agreements a department holds
Check whether a body's appointments are regulated
routes: The UK's relationships: treaties and agreements
Rules that apply, including the public appointments code
personas.success: Names the accountable minister and the evidence for a written question
personas.test: Wants a citable chain more than a visual

personas.goal: Find who is responsible for a body, who funds or owns it, and prove it
tasks: Search a name and read its chain with sources
See money, owners and people with significant control (counted, not named)
Download the evidence
personas.success: A sourced answer they can publish the same day
personas.test: Wants the evidence trail more than the visual

personas.goal: Find who to hold to account and what funding is open to them
tasks: Find the elected body a service answers to
Find grants open to non-profits
Find grant-makers publishing open data
personas.success: One route to the right body, and a shortlist of grants, on a phone
personas.test: Needs plain language and name search on a phone

personas.goal: Understand how the UK state fits together
tasks: See the three branches in each nation
Explore the org charts
Look up unfamiliar terms
personas.success: Can explain who makes laws, runs services and settles disputes in their nation
personas.test: Learns most from the interactive charts and plain-English panels

personas.goal: Analyse how the state has changed and what it costs, with stable identifiers
tasks: Download dated editions and the concordance
Query everything in SQL
Compare with international registers
personas.success: Reproduces a figure from the published data and method
personas.test: Values the method and bulk data more than search

personas.who: Founder in fintech, medtech, regtech, govtech or another innovative sector
personas.goal: Find the regulator, its innovation services and the funding that fits
tasks: Find a regulator's sandbox or advice office
Find grants and schemes for their sector
See which rules apply to the bodies they will sell to
personas.success: A named service or grant to apply to this week
personas.test: Starts from the sector, not from the body

personas.goal: Find finance, advice and support schemes
tasks: Find finance and loans
Find expertise and advice
See who runs each scheme
personas.success: Finds a scheme they are eligible for, with the giver's contact route
personas.test: Needs the filters more than the register

personas.goal: Know which buyers are contracting authorities and how they are organised
tasks: See who the Procurement Act likely applies to
Find a buyer's parent department and nation
Find each buyer's own website
routes: Rules that apply, on each profile
Org chart: who answers to whom
personas.success: A target list of buyers with their places in the structure
personas.test: Uses the type and nation filters heavily

personas.goal: Understand devolution, reorganisation and where their council sits
tasks: See strategic authorities and reorganisation status
Find grants open to local authorities
See the rules that apply to councils
personas.success: Knows their council's status and dates under the 2026 Act
personas.test: Wants their own council's page first

personas.who: Foreign official, diplomat or international organisation staff
personas.goal: Find the UK body that leads on a subject, and the UK's treaties with their country
tasks: Find the UK lead or single point of contact for an organisation
List treaties with a partner
See the Crown Dependencies' and Overseas Territories' own bodies
routes: The UK in the world (org chart)
personas.success: Names the right UK counterpart and its official page

personas.goal: Find out which body does what, and who answers for it
tasks: Search a body by name
See its own website
Find the elected body it answers to
personas.success: Reaches the right body's own website in two clicks
personas.test: Needs plain language and search on a phone

personas.goal: Build on the data safely, and fix what is wrong
tasks: Read the feed contract and change log
Validate the BODS output
Raise a correction with a source
personas.success: Integrates the feed and sees a correction published quickly
personas.test: Judges it on BODS validity, stability and response to fixes

journeys.name: Answer a question
steps: Read the chain and its sources

journeys.name: Explore the state
steps: Start at an elected body or a nation
Filter by type, purpose or nation

journeys.name: Follow the money
steps: See funding, running costs and PFI
See owners and investors (counted, not named)
See what it gives in grants

journeys.name: Find the rules
steps: Read the rules that apply and their scope
Open what it issues on GOV.UK

journeys.name: Find funding or support
steps: Pick who you are or your sector
Filter grants, schemes or innovation services
Open the giver's profile and apply on its site

journeys.name: Work across borders
steps: See the UK lead and mission

journeys.name: Reuse the data
steps: Choose a format or open Datasette Lite

journeys.name: Contribute a fix
steps: See the fix published with credit
